stem.x: Let n be a binary integer represented in two’s complement. Which of the following is the operation that results in the value 9 × n using only bit shifting and an addition or subtraction?

b.x: Shift n 2 bits to the left, then add n to the result.
Shift n 2 bits to the left, then subtract n from the result.
Shift n 3 bits to the left, then add n to the result.
Shift n 3 bits to the left, then subtract n from the result.
